scope: Android+iOS feature API declarations, callback/factory methods, PolarBleApi properties, and external iOS REST protocol; overload/default declarations retained. DTO/enum utility methods and model constructors excluded.

status_meanings.implemented-hardware-unverified: Concrete protocol/function implementation exists; physical device feature behavior is not certified by this mapping.
status_meanings.partial: Concrete subset exists, with a specified semantic or DTO/convenience gap.
status_meanings.planned: No implementation for this capability exists yet.
status_meanings.platform-replacement: Mobile OS contract is replaced or inapplicable on Windows; not a claim of original behavior parity.
